answer: Proposal for buyer-funded yarrow pollen readings: each grower prepays one sample ID before any agent claims it. A buyer-owned sensor signs a crystal-oscillator pulse with the reading; auditors check its signature and the report, then validators pay one receipt per funded ID. A farm can reuse one model and self-order work, but self-payment returns its own escrow minus a burned fee. Each additional profitable key needs another outside-funded sample; borrowed money is not outside demand. Missing proof or a replayed ID earns zero. MinePoA does not enforce this rule.
